about_the_game:
Tainted by the Stars: The Dead Among Us

A 3D top-down zombie shooter focused on tactics, resource scarcity, and realistic combat. Instead of mindless spraying, every fight demands decisions, when to fight, when to run, and when to loot.

Your vision is your greatest weapon: the innovative Field-of-View system only shows what your survivor can actually see, adding tension, realism, and tactical depth to every encounter.

As you fight to stay alive, you’re not just surviving. You’ve been tasked by a group of researchers to uncover the true cause of the zombie outbreak. Every mission brings you closer to the origin of the infection… and the truth behind it.

Survive wave after wave of undead using a mix of firearms, melee weapons, grenades, and healing items. All under the constant pressure of limited ammo and time.

Features

  • Unique Field-of-View system defining visibility and tension

  • Wave-based survival mode with increasing difficulty

  • Detailed ammo and magazine management

  • Distinct melee and ranged combat mechanics

  • Grenades, healing items, flashlight, and night vision

  • Dynamic loot and procedural elements

  • In-depth statistics (accuracy, efficiency, kills, etc.)

  • Minimalist UI and full gamepad support

  • No pay-to-win, no online requirement

content_descriptors.notes:
This game contains stylized depictions of violence and blood. Players engage in combat against zombie-like enemies using firearms, melee weapons, and explosives. While blood effects are present, the violence is not graphic or sadistic in nature. There is no depiction of violence against real people, animals, or vulnerable groups.

The game does not contain sexual content, drug or alcohol use, or self-harm.

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: macOS 11 (Big Sur)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 or Apple M1
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: ntegrated or dedicated GPU with Metal support
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Any macOS-compatible sound device
mac_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: macOS 12 (Monterey) or newer
  • Processor: Apple M1 or newer / Intel Core i5 (2020 or newer)
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Apple M1 GPU or dedicated Metal-compatible GPU
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Any macOS-compatible sound device

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 (64 Bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-6100 oder AMD FX-6300
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 750 Ti oder AMD Radeon R7 360
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX-compatible Sound Card
  • Additional Notes: Keyboard and mouse or gamepad required
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 or 11 (64 Bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 or AMD Ryzen 5 2600
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1060 or AMD Radeon RX 580
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX-compatible Sound Card
  • Additional Notes: SSD recommended for faster loading. Gamepad supported.

short_description: A tactical 3D top-down zombie shooter with an innovative Field-of-View system. Tasked by researchers, you must uncover the cause of the zombie outbreak while managing scarce ammo, using tactics, melee, and grenades to survive endless waves.
